test_memory_bank_model: test the MemoryBank model with a backbone, MLP, temperature, bank_size, and dim parameters
create_memory_bank_instance: create a MemoryBank instance with a Linear backbone, Linear MLP, and configurable temperature and bank size
run_memory_bank_forward: run the MemoryBank forward pass on random tensor inputs with corresponding index tensors
generate_test_inputs: generate random tensor inputs and index tensors for testing the MemoryBank model
setup_test_rng: set up a reproducible random number generator seed for MemoryBank unit tests
